# Porvenir Agencia Digital

> Software Engineering, Web Design & AI agency based in Ciudad Real, Spain. Led by Teresa Rodríguez de Dios (Software Engineer & MSc UX). Three core services: bespoke web design with UX, AI automation and chatbots, and mobile app development. Fully remote, serving clients across Spain and internationally.

## Servicios

- [Diseño Web & UX](https://www.porveniragenciadigital.com/#servicios): Bespoke, ultra-fast, Mobile First websites with Technical SEO. Semantic HTML, Tailwind CSS, and vanilla JavaScript — no templates, no plugins, strategically designed to maximise conversions. UX strategy and WCAG 2.1 accessibility audits included as standard.
- [IA & Automatización](https://www.porveniragenciadigital.com/#servicios): Intelligent chatbots for WhatsApp and web, autonomous AI voice agents that answer, qualify, and route incoming calls 24/7, and bespoke automation flows. Key solution for compliance with Spain's Ley 10/2025 de Atención a la Clientela.
- [Apps Móviles](https://www.porveniragenciadigital.com/#servicios): Native and hybrid iOS and Android applications built with software engineering rigour: clean architecture, AI integration, external APIs, and CRM connections.
- [Formación IA para Empresas](https://www.porveniragenciadigital.com/#servicios): Practical AI training workshops tailored to each business sector, making complex AI concepts accessible and applicable from day one.

## Sobre la agencia

- [Quiénes somos](https://www.porveniragenciadigital.com/#agencia): Teresa Rodríguez de Dios, founder, Software Engineer & MSc in User Experience Design. Engineering foundation combined with UX-first strategy and legal compliance expertise (Ley 10/2025, WCAG 2.1, LOPD/GDPR, EU AI Act).
